summary.key_theme: 市場聚焦於 Tesla 與 SpaceX 合作的 168 億美元 Terafab 晶片工廠計畫，同時面臨自動駕駛安全性疑慮與中國業務分拆傳聞的雙重影響。

bullish.title: Everything’s bigger in Texas: Musk’s planned $16.8 billion chip factory is five times bigger than the world’s current largest building
bullish.reason: Tesla 與 SpaceX 共同投資 168 億美元建設 Terafab 晶片廠，展現公司在 AI 運算與半導體自主供應鏈的長期戰略野心。

bullish.title: Retail traders just drew a line under Tesla’s sell-off
bullish.reason: 散戶投資者展現強大支撐力，成功阻止了 Tesla 近期的拋售潮，顯示市場對該股的底部信心。

bullish.title: Tesla’s Robotaxi Now Ships With Built-In Starlink—Musk Says It’s Coming to Every Car
bullish.reason: 將 Starlink 整合至 Robotaxi 與全車系，強化了 Tesla 生態系統的連網能力與自動駕駛基礎設施。

bullish.title: Cathie Wood's ARK Bought $40 Million of Nvidia, Tesla, and SpaceX During Last Month's AI Sell-Off
bullish.reason: 知名投資機構 ARK 在 AI 修正期間加碼 4000 萬美元，為市場提供正面情緒訊號。

bullish.title: Tesla Just Found Another Way to Grow Without Selling a Car
bullish.reason: 強調 Tesla 轉向自動駕駛與 Robotaxi 服務的成長潛力，降低對單一硬體銷售的依賴。

bullish.title: Byrna, Lucid, Park-Ohio, JELD-WEN, and Tesla Shares Skyrocket
bullish.reason: 受宏觀經濟數據（就業報告）影響，市場出現反彈，Tesla 股價隨大盤走高。

bullish.title: The Zacks Analyst Blog Highlights SpaceX, Tesla KLA Corp, Onto Innovation, Applied Materials and Lam Research
bullish.reason: Terafab 計畫帶動半導體設備需求，提升了相關供應鏈的市場關注度。

bullish.title: Does Tesla’s Terafab Texas Chip Bet Reshape Its AI Ambitions And Margin Story For TSLA?
bullish.reason: 探討 Terafab 對 AI 競爭力與利潤率的長期影響，正面看待其技術垂直整合的潛力。

bearish.title: Tesla Autopilot under scrutiny after crash involving 49ers coach Kyle Shanahan
bearish.reason: 涉及知名人士的自動駕駛事故引發監管審查，可能對 Autopilot 的品牌聲譽與法律責任造成負面影響。

bearish.title: Tesla (TSLA) Rumors Swirl Over China Split Ahead Of Possible Merger
bearish.reason: 關於分拆中國業務的傳聞引發市場對公司結構與地緣政治風險的擔憂。

bearish.title: Tesla Has More to Prove Than Ever, But the Upside Could Be Huge
bearish.reason: 指出雖然交付量創新高，但獲利能力惡化，投資人對 Q2 財報表現持保留態度。

bearish.title: Tesla Stock Slips as Army of Fans Fails to Help It Claw Back Losses
bearish.reason: 顯示散戶買盤力道減弱，股價難以維持漲勢，反映短期賣壓。

bearish.title: Tesla Stock's Deepest Fall Was Worse Than Its Worst Market Crash
bearish.reason: 回顧歷史波動率，提醒投資人該股的高風險特性，可能影響保守型投資人的信心。

bearish.title: See How a Tesla-SpaceX Merger Gives Musk a Shortcut to His $1 Trillion Payday
bearish.reason: 關於合併傳聞的報導引發對公司治理與股東權益的疑慮，市場擔心 Musk 的個人利益與公司利益衝突。

neutral.title: S&P500, Nasdaq, Dow Futures Unchanged After Ending Session Mildly Lower
neutral.reason: 大盤期貨持平，主要受 Intel 財報影響，Tesla 僅被提及為觀察標的，無直接利多或利空。

neutral.title: The Robot ETF Actually Exists Now: Tesla, Hyundai, and the Companies Building the Joints
neutral.reason: 僅報導機器人 ETF 的組成，Tesla 作為成分股之一，未對股價產生直接影響。

neutral.title: Elon Musk Says SpaceX Will Consume Three Times More Terafab AI Compute Than Tesla
neutral.reason: 釐清 SpaceX 與 Tesla 在晶片需求上的分配，屬於營運細節說明，對股價影響中性。

neutral.title: Tesla and SpaceX want their own chip factory with 3,000 workers
neutral.reason: 重複報導 Terafab 計畫細節，補充人力需求資訊，無新增重大影響。

neutral.title: Tesla or SpaceX: Who Benefits More From Terafab and How
neutral.reason: 分析兩家公司在晶片廠的利益分配，屬於中性觀點探討。

neutral.title: Tesla in the spotlight as NFL's 49ers head coach says Autopilot may have been engaged during accident
neutral.reason: 此新聞與後續的 Autopilot 審查報導內容重複，選定後續報導作為代表，此篇歸類為中性資訊更新。
